about: A node graph sends a signal to the client scripts (Lua) of a player: the server node 发送客户端脚本信号 of game 7.1; seen in play on 2026-10-13. Two signals are defined with scene_add_signal, CS_ping and CS_tell (which carries one string, word). The graph writes f.sendSignal('client:CS_ping', player) at level second 9 and f.sendSignal('client:CS_tell', player, 'hello') at second 13: the prefix client: says the signal goes to the scripts of that player, and the player is the argument after the name. The script registers script:RegisterServerSignalHandler(name, function(name, params) ... end) for both in OnStart and prints what arrives: 'CS_LUA got CS_ping with 0 params' in the same second as the graph's CS_SENT ping, 'CS_LUA got CS_tell word hello' with CS_SENT tell. The lamp on the screen is grey at the start, green after the first signal and yellow after the second. The compiler has no such node: the server replaces the send node by it when it writes the graph into the save, and scene_add_signal writes the definition the node needs (a fourth one beside send, listen and send-to-server, byte for byte the one the 7.1 editor adds to a signal).
